tools.name: resolve_vs_query
tools.description: First step for any Team A vs Team B query. Resolves the best matching fixture (live, today FT, most recent past, or upcoming) using Google suggest normalization and inferred-league scan. Returns match_id plus structured home/away teams, or found: false. Do not guess match ids.

tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: List football competition and league API keys. Returns featured major competitions when query is omitted. With query (e.g. World Cup, Premier League), filters featured list or searches footapi. FIFA World Cup key is WorldCupBrazil2014 — use with get_league_fixtures (not get_fixtures, which returns e

tools.name: get_competition_day_fixtures
tools.description: Football fixtures for one competition on one date. Resolves league key automatically (World Cup → WorldCupBrazil2014). query examples: World Cup, Premier League, Champions League. Always call this for 'fixtures today' — do not guess dates or schedules.

tools.name: get_live_scores
tools.description: Get currently live football matches and scores. All timestamps are GMT/UTC.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: Get detailed match information (events, lineups, stats) with optional head-to-head data

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Get detailed player information (stats, career) by player ID

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Get detailed team information (squad, stats) by team ID

tools.name: get_team_image
tools.description: Get team logo PNG URL by team ID

tools.name: health
tools.description: Health check - echo back a message

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for teams, players, or competitions by name

tools.name: get_network_identity
tools.description: Where this user's requests to the site leave from (a VPN country, the server, or the app's default) and which browser they present. Read-only.

tools.name: set_network_identity
tools.description: Choose where this user's requests to the site leave from and which browser they present, only when the user asks (e.g. 'connect through Nigeria', 'use my own user agent'). Sites may ask the user to sign in again when this changes. reset=true goes back to how they signed in.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
